units.lore: 단수된 골목에 마지막까지 물을 날랐다. 가장 먼저 불려 나오는 수호자가 주민들의 얼굴을 가장 많이 기억한다.
units.prompt: A small stout adult female neighborhood water carrier, navy bob haircut, round friendly face, teal waterproof apron over cobalt work clothes, knee-high rubber boots. ONE large circular transparent water reservoir strapped to her back, visible around both shoulders, two thick blue hoses connected to short brass wrist nozzles. Clear blue water visible inside tank. Silver buckles, practical patched fabric, approachable novice rescuer.

units.lore: 대피소 취사장의 불을 처음 되살린 견습공. 작은 화력이라도 꺼지지 않게 돌보는 것이 자기 일이다.
units.prompt: Petite adult female ignition mechanic apprentice, many freckles, bright curly red hair in a high ponytail, oversized round goggles on forehead, orange work overalls over a crimson shirt. ONE oversized heatproof gauntlet on right forearm. Short flared-muzzle brass ignition pistol in an open holster outside left thigh, large exposed flint wheel and tiny red fuel bottle attached. Sturdy short work boots, bright expressive confident face, modest practical equipment.

units.lore: 빙고 창고 문을 잠그던 막내 관리인. 서리줄을 쳐 물자가 굴러 떨어지는 것을 막던 기술을 적에게 쓴다.
units.prompt: Thin lanky adult male frost-line apprentice, spiky mint hair, short cream scarf leaving nose and face visible, bulky pale blue quilted vest, slim limbs, silver-blue work trousers. Large HEXAGONAL reel on belt holding a short metal chain with THREE chunky translucent ice segments at its end, neatly docked outside hip. Frostproof mitt cuffs with fingers visible, small sturdy boots, earnest angular face.

units.desc: 방전 화살이 옆으로 한 번 뛴다
units.lore: 끊긴 전선에 임시 연결줄을 쏘던 수습 기사. 아직 먼 곳까지는 못 잇지만 바로 옆 한 사람은 놓치지 않는다.
units.prompt: Small adult female electrical line-archer apprentice, round attentive eyes, short violet hair, cropped lime-green insulated vest, oversized white ceramic elbow guards. Small U-SHAPED bow with TWO large copper electrode spheres at its tips strapped vertically behind left shoulder, visible outside body. Short copper arrow quiver with hooked arrowheads, purple trousers, rubber-soled boots, practical bright novice design.

units.desc: 종이 칼날이 쉴 새 없이 나간다
units.lore: 카지노 수리용으로 만들어졌지만 피난민들이 붙여 준 이름을 가장 소중히 여긴다. 자기 키보다 낮은 틈을 맡는다.
units.prompt: Small waist-high humanoid wooden maintenance automaton, round ivory faceplate with TWO black eyes and one small dot, short chunky limbs. ONE large exposed brass clockwork gear centered in chest, ivory and graphite work vest, short wide saw-toothed sword secured vertically outside hip. Wooden articulated fingers and feet, charming practical toy-like construction, single clearly readable gear and saw silhouette, restrained brass accents without elemental glow.

units.lore: 항만 펌프장이 멈췄을 때 수동으로 밤을 버틴 정비반장. 탄 수를 세며 싸우는 버릇이 있다.
units.prompt: Stocky middle-aged male harbor pump foreman with broad square jaw, white sideburns, navy sailor cap and short cobalt raincoat over round belly. His defining weapon is a HUGE BRASS WATER REVOLVER openly mounted outside left thigh, with SIX LARGE TRANSPARENT CYLINDERS filled with vivid BLUE WATER arranged around its central barrel. These clear cyan water tubes and the broad brass nozzle are entirely exposed and clearly distinguish it from an ordinary firearm. Visible pump handle, short navy trousers, heavy sea boots. Friendly weathered face, silver coat buckles. The bright blue transparent cylinder cluster is a major silhouette feature.

units.lore: 폭풍에 끊긴 대피 항로를 신호탄으로 이어 준 궁수. 가장 멀리 보이는 불이 가장 안전한 길이던 때를 기억한다.
units.prompt: Slender long-necked adult female signal-flare archer, tall red topknot, triangular brass ear guards, cropped crimson riding jacket with orange panels, fitted trousers and flat riding boots. Distinctive SUN-SEMICIRCLE brass bow strapped vertically outside left thigh, orange heating wire inside curved limb. Thick signal arrows with large orange capsule tips in a side quiver, three red fuel compartments on belt. Alert elegant face, clear open silhouette.

units.lore: 겨울 산길에 구조 통로를 내던 개척대원. 넘어질 사람을 위해 미끄러운 길에도 반드시 발 디딜 곳을 남긴다.
units.prompt: Enormous adult male ice-path pioneer, square white beard, round polar-bear-like padded hood, very broad pale cyan shoulders, small silver eyes. Wide SPADE-SHAPED ice greatsword secured vertically outside left leg, broad flat translucent blue blade with coolant channels. Three vertical ice crampon fins on each shin, quilted silver-blue exploration suit, giant boots, warm rugged face, clean chunky silhouette.

units.lore: 꺼진 골목의 전등을 하나씩 이어 켜던 배선공. 연결된 것들이 함께 버틴다는 믿음을 공격 기술로 쓴다.
units.prompt: Tall slender adult female live-wire technician, black hair tied low with spiky violet side locks, short lime electrical jacket. TWO thick violet cables running from collar to hips, large copper cable reel on one hip, THREE large copper crocodile clips clustered at the cable tip docked outside opposite thigh. White ceramic forearm guards, heavy insulating purple boots, visible thoughtful face, long flowing cable silhouette kept neat.

units.lore: 카지노 물품을 운반하던 인형이 압착기를 바꿔 달았다. 사람을 안을 때는 압력을 가장 낮은 칸에 둔다.
units.prompt: Stout round-bellied ivory rescue automaton with square shoulders, friendly semicircular smile on simple faceplate. Huge SQUARE PRESS PLATE centered in chest, matching smaller square hydraulic plates mounted on both forearms. TWO folded mechanical braces secured flat to back. Ivory painted metal, graphite joints, restrained brass pistons, chunky articulated hands and flat feet. Cheerful compact mechanical silhouette, solid physical construction, no elemental effects.

units.desc: 세 발이 저마다 다른 길로 간다
units.lore: 안개 속에서 구조선 세 척을 동시에 인도하던 항로사. 누구 하나 남기지 않으려 세 목표를 함께 겨눈다.
units.prompt: An adult female triple-shot water archer. Her main defining feature is ONE ENORMOUS TRIPLE-LIMBED BOW displayed vertically immediately outside her LEFT LEG, fully assembled and uncovered from shoulder height to ankle. The bow has THREE broad curved bronze limbs arranged in an open fan around a central aquamarine stock, three clearly visible strings and three blue arrow guide rails. The entire bow silhouette must be visibly separate from her body. Lean adult build, angular face, short brown hair, three-lens aqua goggles on forehead, short blue-gray hood capelet, navy fitted navigator uniform, one compact three-slot quiver at right hip, practical boots. The large visible fan bow dominates the equipment design.

units.lore: 불탄 거리에서 길을 치우던 청소반장. 살아 있는 사람이 지나갈 한 줄을 남기기 위해 싸운다.
units.prompt: Short broad middle-aged female ash sweeper, cropped gray hair, dust respirator over mouth leaving alert eyes visible, brick-red heatproof apron over orange work clothes. Her main tool is a FLEXIBLE CHAIN WHIP with a broad flat tassel of short copper metal bristles at its weighted tip. A large loop of exposed BLACK METAL CHAIN hangs from the left belt to knee and curves back to a clearly visible broad COPPER BRISTLE HEAD docked outside the thigh. Every large chain link is visible and the tool has a short handheld grip, showing it bends like a whip. Large black ash canister on right hip, reinforced boots, practical heatproof forearm guards.

units.lore: 붕괴 직전의 교각 아래를 얼려 대피 시간을 벌었다. 말 대신 자기 발이 버티는 곳을 가리킨다.
units.prompt: Huge bald adult male cryogenic foundation worker, square jaw, small ears, quiet human face. EXTREME ASYMMETRY: left boot is an enormous square industrial cold-stamping press as wide as his thigh, right boot normal sized. Large white-and-cyan cooling tank on back, thick turquoise hose visibly descending to giant boot. Pale blue insulated overalls, compact upper body armor, bare articulated hands. Heavy blocky silhouette grounded on both feet.

units.lore: 달리는 전차에 전력을 넘겨 주던 기동 정비공. 망설이기 전에 손이 먼저 나가지만 두 번째 동작은 정확하다.
units.prompt: Youthful-faced ADULT male capacitor speed swordsman, short upright lime hair, fitted PURPLE lightweight jacket, slim athletic build and purple rubber racing boots. TWO FAT ROUND COPPER BATTERY CANISTERS with bright LIME cylinders mounted horizontally at left and right waist, blunt flat circular caps clearly showing they are batteries. Exposed large brass COIL SPRING mechanisms wrap the OUTSIDE OF BOTH ELBOWS and are visible with arms straight in T-pose. ONE SHORT BROAD STRAIGHT SILVER SWORD mounted fully uncovered vertically beside LEFT THIGH, single bright lime line along BARE blade, clear hilt guard, blade distinctly separate from round batteries. Compact fast melee fighter, cheerful determined visible face.

units.lore: 카지노 폐장 뒤를 순찰하던 경비 인형. 정해진 길을 벗어나지 못하던 몸이 지금은 피난 통로를 지킨다.
units.prompt: Tall lanky humanoid casino security automaton, long nose-shaped ivory faceplate, round black eyes, painted white-shirt torso and short gray waistcoat, exposed circular wooden shoulder and elbow joints. Long pneumatic rifle with THREE vertically arranged chamber windows secured upright outside right leg, three small compressed-air cylinders on back connected by graphite tubes. Brass hinges, long flat mechanical feet, attentive face, elegant simple physical silhouette.

units.lore: 침수 구역에서 사람들을 끌어내던 현장 대장. 공격 후 호스를 잡아당기는 복귀 동작도 구조 작업 그대로다.
units.prompt: Muscular athletic adult female flood rescue captain, tanned skin, short orange cropped hair, sleeveless cobalt rescue jumpsuit, orange life ring attached to one shoulder. Large exposed blue fire-hose reel fixed outside right hip, flattened hose coiled into it, broad fan-shaped brass nozzle holstered at the opposite hip. Thick wrist braces, reinforced rubber boots, determined open face. Powerful shoulders and clearly visible mechanical hose reel.

units.lore: 무너진 전차 문을 절단해 승객을 꺼내던 검사. 허세 섞인 인사 뒤에는 늘 탈출로부터 확인한다.
units.prompt: Lean athletic adult male thermal swordsman, angular jaw, slicked-back dark red hair, cropped vivid red work jacket and ONE oversized brass shoulder heat shield. His defining weapon is a LARGE BROAD STRAIGHT SABER mounted entirely uncovered vertically outside his left leg, visible from waist to ankle, the BARE SILVER BLADE prominently exposed. ONE thick RED HEATING COIL runs the full length along the back edge of the blade, joined by copper cable to its trigger grip and a small red fuel cartridge at belt. Charcoal fitted trousers with orange seams, tall work boots, confident smile. The visible red-hot thermal blade is the visual focal point.

units.lore: 냉동 창고 연무 속에서 길을 찾던 경비원. 보이지 않는 적을 무작정 쫓지 않고 가까운 공간부터 확보한다.
units.prompt: Compact adult female cryogenic SHOTGUN guard, short platinum hair, goggles pushed onto forehead, uncovered focused face, short filter mask resting at neck. Angular sky-blue insulated jacket and fitted dark blue trousers, three coolant bottles on belt, knee guards and snow boots. ONE SINGLE LARGE DOUBLE-BARRELED SHOTGUN mounted uncovered vertically just outside LEFT LEG. This one weapon has ONE wooden stock, ONE trigger, and TWO huge WIDE SHORT PARALLEL BARRELS sharing the same silver body. Both wide muzzle openings have visible perforated blue diffuser plates, the weapon is bulky and wide rather than thin or long. Entire gun is exposed from hip to shin, two small mounting clips only. Other hip carries coolant bottles only.

units.lore: 번개가 치는 날에도 꼭대기 전선을 점검하던 접지공. 위험한 전류가 사람을 피해 흐를 길을 먼저 만든다.
units.prompt: Elderly male lightning grounding engineer with stooped shoulders but upright standing posture, long tied white beard, violet work mantle covering shoulders. ONE exceptionally tall THREE-PRONG copper lightning rod on backpack rising high above head, large round copper palm plates attached to open hands, thick grounding cables down the backs of his purple rubber boots. Lime insulating panels, deeply lined kind face, narrow tall antenna silhouette.

units.desc: 잔상이 같은 화살을 한 번 더 쏜다
units.lore: 대피소 치수를 재던 계측기사. 첫 기록이 틀릴 수 있어 언제나 한 번 더 확인하던 버릇이 무기가 됐다.
units.prompt: A silver-gray short-haired FEMALE ARCHER wearing an IVORY WHITE short-sleeved surveying jacket, fitted CHARCOAL BLACK trousers and gray boots, one round BRASS MONOCLE on one eye. Her TWO NATURAL HUMAN ARMS have exposed skin forearms and empty human hands in horizontal T-pose. A HUGE DOUBLE ARCHERY BOW stands visibly beside her left leg, TWO silver curved bow limbs paired in parallel with TWO CLEAR STRINGS and small brass connecting bridges. The large bow is completely exposed from above shoulder to ankle, bow and strings clearly separate from the character silhouette. A small brass AUTOMATIC STRING-RELEASE CLAMP fixed at the central bow grip explains the delayed second arrow. Compact single gray arrow quiver at right hip. Cool silver, ivory and charcoal palette. Keep the reference standing pose and prominent visible bow, transform the clothing and hair to the white-gray surveyor design.

units.lore: 무너진 갑문을 잘라 갇힌 배를 꺼내던 기술자. 잘라야 할 것은 적과 생존자 사이의 장애물뿐이라고 말한다.
units.prompt: Huge adult male sluice cutter, broad robust torso, sea-green short beard, teal heavy diving work suit with massive forearms, brass hydraulic upper-arm pistons and oversized diver boots. His defining weapon is an ENORMOUS WIDE HOOK-TIPPED CLEAVER GREATSWORD mounted fully exposed vertically beside his LEFT LEG. This blade runs from SHOULDER TO FLOOR, is as wide as his thigh and curls forward into a hooked nose at its bottom tip. Thick transparent blue water channel follows the inner blade edge. Entire uncovered broad hooked blade visibly separated from body on two tiny metal clips. Cobalt knee panels, silver rivets, rugged friendly human face.

units.lore: 지하 난방관을 놓던 공사 책임자. 붕괴된 지하도에 공기를 넣기 위해 처음으로 땅을 공격했다.
units.prompt: Enormous bald adult male geothermal demolition foreman, broad nose, short black beard, round furnace belly armor, TWO short chimney pipes behind neck. Two gigantic rectangular brass piston gauntlets, several times larger than hands, with heat nozzles on lower faces. Crimson industrial coveralls, orange boiler windows, stone-thick knee guards and broad work boots. Very broad square industrial silhouette, friendly stubborn human face.

units.lore: 설원에서 실종자의 발자국을 찾던 추적자. 적의 발도 눈 위에서 오래 멈추게 만든다.
units.prompt: Tall flexible adult female snow-trail archer, white hair in two long braids, pointed fox-ear-shaped pale blue winter cap, short white-blue capelet ending at waist. Beautiful silver bow with a large HEXAGONAL SNOWFLAKE ring at its grip, strapped vertically outside left side, broad folding six-petal arrowheads in side quiver. Fitted cyan ranger clothing, fur-trimmed flat boots, clear alert face, no animal companion.

units.desc: 같은 놈을 다섯 번 맞히면 터진다
units.lore: 전차 배터리를 검사하던 순회 기사. 숫자를 끝까지 확인한 뒤에야 괜찮다고 말하는 성격이다.
units.prompt: Dark-skinned athletic adult male electrical inspection officer, angular face, short violet flat-top hair, lime-green leather maintenance jacket. Large FIVE-SEGMENT horizontal capacitor meter on chest, chunky rectangular copper-and-purple electric pistol in open outside-thigh holster with twin top electrodes. Visible copper line from back of hand to hip battery, neat ceramic knuckle plates, rubber work boots, dependable serious eyes.

units.lore: 좁은 잔해 틈의 철근을 잘라 구조하던 절단사. 정면에서 닿지 않는 곳에도 도구가 돌아 들어갈 길을 찾는다.
units.prompt: Lean adult female articulated-blade rescue cutter, high cheekbones, distinctive half-shaved black hair, ONE oversized ivory shoulder plate and fitted graphite work suit. Her main defining weapon is a HUGE FLEXIBLE SEGMENTED BLADE WHIP: twelve LARGE RECTANGULAR SILVER BLADE LINKS with clearly visible brass hinges between them. This long articulated blade forms a large OPEN C-SHAPED loop mounted on a crescent rail outside her LEFT HIP, extending from waist to knee, all rectangular segments completely visible and separate from body silhouette. One end has a short black handle, the other a broad chisel blade. White shin guards, brass rotary wrist controller, practical work boots, uncovered alert human face. The curved segmented metal blade dominates her silhouette.

units.lore: 화재 때 도시의 빗물 저장소를 개방했던 수리기사. 물을 아끼라는 명령보다 사람을 살리라는 부탁을 택했다.
units.prompt: Tall stately middle-aged female rainworks engineer, silver hair in a thick practical bun, long split navy engineering coat over fitted teal trousers. A huge circular aquamarine irrigation ring mechanically mounted on her back, wider than shoulders and visible above her head like a solid pipe halo, SIX thick hanging water tubes forming a structured skirt silhouette. Brass chest valve and compact back pump. Grounded waterproof boots, dignified capable face.

units.lore: 피난 행렬의 옆길을 혼자 막던 호위대원. 사람들이 발걸음을 멈추지 않도록 총성을 일정하게 맞춘다.
units.prompt: Athletic adult female dual-pistol escort, lively face, curly black hair in two short side bunches, cropped red bolero over orange protective bodice, fitted riding trousers. Fan-shaped COPPER COOLING FINS around hips like a short mechanical ruffle, two chunky crimson pistols secured in open outer-thigh holsters, orange ammunition magazines strapped to both thighs. Compact heat vents, sturdy boots, energetic elegant industrial fantasy design.

units.lore: 얼음에 갇힌 짐과 사람을 함께 끌어올리던 인양공. 무거울수록 웃으며 다른 사람부터 손을 놓게 한다.
units.prompt: Round stout adult male ice-salvage winch master, broad friendly face, thick blond mustache, sky-blue insulated snowsuit wider at belly than shoulders. ONE large salvage pulley rising behind head, two heavy silver chain wheels at hips, thick ice-segment chain neatly coiled with a broad ANCHOR-SHAPED ice hook docked beside right thigh. Oversized grippy snow boots, brass crank handles, cheerful robust industrial fantasy character.

units.desc: 화살이 가까운 놈으로 두 번 뛴다
units.lore: 산봉우리 중계탑을 잇던 통신 궁수. 한 곳이 끊겨도 다음 연결 지점을 즉시 찾아낸다.
units.prompt: Athletic adult female relay-network archer, high cheekbones, short asymmetrical silver hair, lime and violet ranger jacket, triangular folded insulated collar. THREE large copper electrode nodes forming a clear triangle above back, bow with three-pronged forked limbs strapped vertically outside left side. Three narrow purple arrow tubes at hip, white ceramic fittings, sturdy climbing boots, watchful uncovered face, sharp triangular silhouette.

units.lore: 높은 철골 위에서 잔해를 해체하던 기사. 허공에 남는 두 번째 궤적 때문에 사람들이 유령이라고 불렀다.
units.prompt: Tall thin adult male counterweight blade knight, white hair tied behind ears, long gray eyebrows, short split ivory coat over fitted graphite armor. TWO narrow vertical counterweight rails on back extending above shoulders. Long sword with TWO curved sickle-like blade sections on one spine secured vertically outside left leg, visible brass hinge between the main and trailing blade. Slim weighted boots, restrained silver surfaces, calm visible human face.

units.lore: 입항 신호를 담당했던 포수. 지금도 세 번째 발사 뒤에는 살아 있는 배가 듣기를 바라며 경적을 울린다.
units.prompt: Broad-chested middle-aged Black male harbor artillery officer, neatly rounded white beard, flat navy harbor officer cap, layered silver shell-shaped shoulder guards, vivid royal-blue reinforced coat. A huge spiral-conch pressure cannon mounted VERTICALLY on a rigid back cradle beside right shoulder, flared trumpet muzzle visible above shoulder, connected by blue hose to cylindrical pressure tank. Heavy sailor boots, brass chest pressure gauge, resolute face.

units.lore: 산간 역에서 밤하늘에 구조 좌표를 올리던 관측관. 밝은 궤적을 보면 아직 구조를 기다리는 사람이 있다는 뜻이다.
units.prompt: Very tall slender mature female meteor-flare observer, long black hair tied low, orange observation hood pushed back revealing face, funnel-shaped copper shoulder guards, red long split field coat. SIX tall signal-rocket tubes mounted visibly above back, broad orange rocket caps. Long heavy recurved brass bow strapped vertically outside leg with a wide rocket cradle at grip. Observation lenses at belt, solid flat boots, vigilant serious eyes.

units.lore: 빙벽 사이 좁은 통로를 맡았던 방패대장. 두 손으로 길의 양쪽을 막는 기술을 검으로 이어 받았다.
units.prompt: Muscular adult female cross-ice knight, broad jaw, short white braids, silver-and-cyan segmented armor split into two clean halves. Rigid X-SHAPED cooling frame visibly rising behind shoulders. TWO matching wedge-shaped translucent ice swords in open scabbards secured vertically outside both thighs. Broad articulated shoulder plates, short armored skirt panels over trousers, steel snow boots, composed battle-scarred human face.

units.desc: 머리 위로 돌려 방전 필드를 편다
units.lore: 야간 송전탑의 순찰 책임자. 피난소 주변에 아무도 뚫고 지나가지 못할 전기 울타리를 세운다.
units.prompt: Large powerful adult female rotating-grid sentry, short black braids, broad purple shoulder armor layered with feather-shaped lime ceramic insulation plates. Tall U-SHAPED safety support frame rises behind head providing overhead chain clearance. Thick copper chain coiled into a prominent belt reel, sturdy forearm protection, grounded heavy rubber boots. Clear strong human face, shield-like broad industrial silhouette, metallic plates rather than real feathers.

units.lore: 피난소에 칸막이를 세우던 방벽 설계자. 빈 판이라고 불린 장비가 가장 많은 사람의 이름을 지켜 냈다.
units.prompt: Broad powerful adult female deployable-bulwark engineer, very short white hair, angular visible face. Armor built from SIX large smooth MATTE IVORY plates with graphite hinges. Three-section folding wall mounted on back like a folded screen, clear rectangular panels rising beside shoulders. Square pneumatic impact stakes mounted on both forearms, brass compression pistons, thick gray boots. Monumental clean white-plane silhouette with minimal ornament, solid fully clothed human character.

units.lore: 심해 관측소 구조 임무에서 돌아온 잠수대장. 두꺼운 외피 뒤에 숨어 있는 목표까지 찾아낸다.
units.prompt: Tall athletic androgynous adult deep-sea harpoon commander, shaved sides and tied navy hair, one round aqua optical targeting lens over an eye. Streamlined indigo diving armor with ONE tall shark-fin-shaped dorsal back plate. Extremely long narrow aquamarine harpoon bow strapped vertically outside left side from shoulder to ankle, two transparent compression chambers around its central grip, three-grooved harpoon tip. Silver rib reinforcements, strong grounded boots.

units.desc: 불채찍이 제 둘레를 한 바퀴 돈다
units.lore: 성당 급식소 화덕을 지키던 수도사. 자신을 중심으로 안전한 원을 만들고 사람들을 그 안으로 부른다.
units.prompt: Sturdy mature bald female firebreak nun-engineer, warm stern human face, short crimson monastic work tunic over orange padded trousers, scorched gold gorget. Huge EIGHT-SEGMENT brass burner ring around waist, heavy iron chain coiled neatly and fastened on one side of ring, heatproof gloves. Broad flat pivot-friendly boots, compact sleeves leaving elbows articulated. Circular mechanical waist silhouette and bold red-gold palette.

Silver insulation piping, fitted blue trousers and grounded boots. Precise symmetrical architectural silhouette, face uncovered.

units.desc: 한 번만 휘둘러 젖음을 세 겹 남긴다
